research_attempts.query_text: Mary Brock: visually checked NARA index; NARA Army-series and CIA OSS context; exact-name searches with OSS, employer, occupation, NBC, reporter, Tehran, Ankara, newspaper, obituary, directory, and archival terms; current loc.gov check.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: The 1942 NBC reporter in Tehran shares the indexed name but lacks a middle name, identifier, direct OSS reference, and Box linkage; numerous other common-name candidates were unrelated.
research_attempts.research_notes: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.
research_attempts.next_action: Review Box 81 for identity and any connection to the NBC candidate.

research_attempts.query_text: Mildred L Brockdorff: visually checked NARA index; NARA and CIA OSS context; exact-name searches with OSS, employer, occupation, Department of State, Biographic Information Division, newspaper, obituary, directory, and archival terms; current loc.gov and official-register checks.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Official 1949-1954 State Department records are postwar and lack direct OSS or Box linkage; a 1942 Mildred Peacock Brockdorff newspaper result does not match the indexed middle initial.
research_attempts.research_notes: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed. Postwar State Department work is not back-projected into the wartime record.
research_attempts.next_action: Review Box 81 for identity, wartime chronology, and pre-OSS affiliation.
